games.name: Void Incremental [v0.1]
games.desc:
You're trapped in a void, where darkness is so powerful, that nothing takes form as anything solid would under the light. Your only goal... Rebuild the glory that once was.

Welcome to Void Incremental! an incremental game about, well, the void. Alongside some other things. Do you love seeing numbers go up? I sure do.
Do note that this game is in an early release. Dont expect alot of things from the current state.

Largely inspired by Grass Cutting Incremental and Not JJT Upgrade Tree (rip) You should check those out too!
Credits present in main menu and bonus pillars.

Tips:
- Right click an upgrade to instantly buy max of it.
- Your first goal is to buy the fifth Void Mass upgrade at least once. You'll know where to go from there.
- Don't trust vobert. Remember to never trust a WORD he utters.
